name: codex
description: Run OpenAI Codex jobs as native background subagents (codex:luna, codex:sol, codex:astra, codex:terra): the native task list, SendMessage, TaskStop and finish notifications, with approvals and a live pane.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI binary (needs `codex app-server`). When this path does not exist, `codex` is looked up on PATH.

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Node 18+ used to run the bridge process. When this path does not exist, `node` is looked up on PATH.

defaultEffort.title: Default effort
defaultEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for every model when the prompt sets no effort: header line. per-model: each model's own default, luna max and sol, astra and terra high.

defaultSandbox.title: Default sandbox
defaultSandbox.description: Sandbox when the prompt sets no sandbox: header line.

defaultApprovals.title: Default approvals
defaultApprovals.description: auto: Codex's own reviewer decides on escalations (looser than Claude auto mode); ask: you approve each in a dialog; never: the sandbox alone decides. The full bypass, yolo, is never a user-wide default: only an explicit request or a project's .claude/codex.json sets it.
